summary: Backend regression for Oct 7 2026 fix to the storefront-shows-supplier-raw-name bug (reconcile_live_names + _mirror_name_to_tiles field-priority fix in backend/routes/supplier_sync.py). Created /app/backend/tests/test_reconcile_live_names_iter251.py (7 tests, all PASS, 5.74s). Verified: (1) health GET /api/supplier-sync/products/live-pricing returns 200; (2) THE ACTUAL BUG — seeded supplier_products with product_name='Moonstone Ivory 30x60cm Matt', display_name=None, name/our_product_name='Moonlight Ivory 30X60' (stale); POST /api/supplier-sync/products/reconcile-live-names returned fixed=1 and the tiles doc's name AND display_name AND website_name were all overwritten to 'Moonstone Ivory 30x60cm Matt' — exactly the shape of the SGSP16 prod bug, now fixed; (3) legacy display_name-only shape still reconciles correctly (fixed=1); (4) idempotency — second run returns fixed=0; (5) full-scan POST with no skus filter + limit=500 returns 200 with {checked:int,fixed:int,examples:list} and did NOT error/timeout on the preview DB (broadened $or query works); (6) quick-update display_name mirror regression (TEST 1) still green; (7) tile DB verification confirms new name is persisted on tiles collection, which is what serialize_tile_for_shop renders on the storefront. Cleanup verified — zero TEST_RECONCILE_ leaks, LP-1611 untouched.
critical_code_review_comments: reconcile_live_names() loads full supplier_products docs via find(query, {'_id':0}) but only uses sku + product_name/display_name/name — a projection {sku:1,supplier_code:1,product_name:1,display_name:1,name:1,display_code:1} would cut network bytes significantly on the 1000s-docs full scan path.

The $or query '{product_name:{$exists:true,$ne:""}} OR {display_name:...}' matches docs where EITHER field is a non-empty string, but it will still return docs whose target_name resolves to only 'name' when product_name/display_name are both {$ne:''} but None — minor, the inner `if not target_name: continue` guard handles it, so correctness is fine; just dead-work for the scan.

_mirror_name_to_tiles() unconditionally sets website_name = name on every call; on legacy docs that intentionally had a separate website_name this would clobber it. Not a bug for the current data shape but worth noting if website_name is ever reintroduced as an independent field.
test_credentials: None required — endpoints are internal admin, no auth.
seed_data_creation: Two temporary supplier_products + tiles docs with SKU TEST_RECONCILE_SKU_1 and TEST_RECONCILE_SKU_2; auto-removed in teardown. LP-1611 verified unchanged (name='Alabaster 80x160cm Polished', product_name/display_name/our_product_name=None on supplier_products; display_name='Alabaster 80x160cm Polished' on tiles).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The reconcile-live-names + _mirror_name_to_tiles priority fix is verified green against the preview DB. The test harness at /app/backend/tests/test_reconcile_live_names_iter251.py is self-cleaning and safe to re-run as a regression. Note BASE_URL must be read from /app/frontend/.env (not os.environ) because /app/backend/tests/conftest.py only loads backend/.env — pattern used in this file via dotenv_values('/app/frontend/.env').
rca of the issue: Pre-fix: (a) _mirror_name_to_tiles() picked `display_name or product_name or name` — in docs like SGSP16 display_name=None so it fell through to name/our_product_name (stale supplier value); (b) reconcile_live_names() queried only {display_name:{$exists,$ne:''}} so docs where only product_name was set were silently skipped. Fix: both now follow `product_name || display_name || name` (matching SupplierProducts.js admin list priority) and the query matches {product_name OR display_name}. Verified by reproducing exact SGSP16 shape in test seed and confirming reconcile returns fixed=1 and persists correct name on tiles.
